# Mammoth

Mammoth 1.13.0 by Michael Williamson:
https://github.com/mwilliamson/mammoth.js
https://www.npmjs.com/package/mammoth/v/1.13.0

Unmodified standalone browser bundle, including its dependencies.
Licensed under BSD 2-Clause; see LICENSE.
Loaded in a local worker only when a visitor selects a DOCX file.
Only raw text is extracted; generated HTML is never inserted into the page.
